title: AF 3 day full body
author: Joanna Lackaye
desc: The AF 3 Day Full Body program is a comprehensive strength training plan designed for beginners looking to build a solid foundation in just one week. With three sessions packed into 60 minutes each, you'll engage all major muscle groups through a variety of effective exercises, including Goblet Squats, Romanian Deadlifts, and Push-Ups. This program requires access to a full gym and emphasizes controlled movements to ensure proper form and maximize gains. Get ready to elevate your fitness journey with a balanced approach that strengthens your body from head to toe!

ex.note: 2-3 sets, 12-15 - slow down if it’s not burning enough
Standing or kneeling or swap with another ab exercise
